entities.name: SYF2 Q6CPI4
observations: Exact 221-aa sequence match to reviewed Kluyveromyces lactis pre-mRNA-splicing factor SYF2 (Q6CPI4); sequence analysis reports 100% identity and coverage.
Annotated as involved in pre-mRNA splicing and localized to the nucleus.
Pfam scan identifies SYF2 domain PF08231 at residues 98–218.

Saccharomyces cerevisiae SYF2 homolog is described as a Prp19/NTC-associated spliceosome component involved in spliceosome maturation after U4 snRNA dissociation; cell-cycle effects may be secondary to inefficient TUB1 splicing.
